test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Based on the above, how is K related to R if ‘L + K ÷ D × P − R’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: L + K ÷ D × P − R

L + K → L is the father of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0294240c8f1fcaf13fe7106be7b9961489d5ff19a145fa0a2ba510d2feb530e.png] 

K ÷ D → K is the sister of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d53ff63ed6203ad80ac180514fec4a07159115191a3e7ecc4f2cdc091a53a7e8.png] 

D × P → D is the mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e039990a5ec6d5e759e9385c43a1296f56cf148562fe7476b753a56dccd2084f.png] 

P − R → P is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0467eace6ac428bb8af9e03bce63cb0df2859a2e13a5e63c0423736bed552c9c.png] 

Thus, K is R's mother's sister or maternal aunt.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
